about: R2 CAST (PLAN-P §4.2) -> A4 ART-INTEG / R3 HOME / R4 LOADING / R8 EVENT-ART. What landed where and the ONE mapping step each consumer needs. Nothing under App/, Tests/, UITests/ or ui.json was edited by R2 (hot files: App/Shell/Home/** is A2 -> B1 -> A4 -> A5).

recipes.art/pipeline/items/char_d1kit.py: helper (no ASSETS): D1 room map + LIGHT_D1, palettes, wood/canvas/rock/wear v-functions, painted metal, the BANDED FUR BLEND, arrow boards, lantern
recipes.art/pipeline/items/char_boss.py: boss v2 model + RIGS['boss_home'] + route3d cases char_bossStage (proof) and char_bossStation (the scaffold rendered from the rig camera)
recipes.art/pipeline/items/char_cast_d1.py: loading figures, event figures, 8 avatars (ASSETS char_<id>)
recipes.art/review/tools/r2_cast.py: recompose / idle / sheets / composed proofs + copygate / lane manifest

commands.rigs: PY art/pipeline/items/char_make.py rig boss_home dig_homeL dig_homeR   (each ~10-20 min; one at a time; >= 1 GB free swap)
commands.rig re-place only: PY art/ui/tools/rig.py --recipes art/pipeline/items <rig> --skip-render   (after editing the `place` target in the recipe)
commands.figures: PY art/pipeline/items/char_make.py render char_bossLoading char_digCart char_digFlyer char_digPop1 char_digPop2 char_digClawPair char_digRacers char_digBalloon char_avatarMiner ...
commands.proofs: PY art/review/tools/r2_cast.py recompose; ... idle; ... sheet boss crew swaps figures avatars; ... home; ... loading; ... profile; ... manifest

rig_mapping_A4.rule: the new rigs carry the SAME layer names, groups, group defaults and pivot names as the rigs they replace, so PuppetStage, PuppetPart.scientistArms and every ui.json puppet track apply unchanged; only the folder names change
sites (grep before editing; names only,: App/Resources/Tuning/ui.json puppet.<rig> keys (3; the track bodies unchanged)

Tests/ShellTests.swift:22,39,42,47,236 (rig names; the pinned facts hold: boss rest layers == {torso, armL, armR, headSmile}, neck pivot, left eyes default eyes_open + feet pivot, right eyes default eyes_half, cycles 3.16 / 10.2 / 17.3)
rig_mapping_A4.boss_frame: 190 x 164 pt, 66.8 pt/u, the scientist's camera: ui.json's torso scaleY pivot [95.3, 164.0] (= the frame's bottom centre) stays valid
rig_mapping_A4.boss_station: the scaffold rail + brass lever is NOT a rig layer (ShellTests pins the rest layers). It is char_bossStation (route3d, same camera / frame as the rig): draw it where homeConsole is drawn today, i.e. BETWEEN Puppet(.excluding(scientistArms)) and Puppet(.only(scientistArms)); R3 HOME owns the shipped homeScaffold (it may re-render char_boss.station() from this camera)
rig_mapping_A4.placements: rig.json placement_pt = the D1 draft spots (art-direction §3.1): boss right of centre (frame top-left ~(200, 180)), Digger L feet (70, 606), Digger R feet (318, 606); R3 owns the final composition (change the `place` target and re-export with --skip-render)
rig_mapping_A4.left wave: dig_homeL has armL (default, the paw on the hip) + armL_wave (raised, palm to camera) exactly like wk_homeL_blue; the old characters-lane finding stands: ui.json's armL rotation -25 swings the resting paw INTO the body -- the motion owner may switch that beat to the armL_wave member (not changed by R2)
